no-restricted-globals.name: crypto
no-restricted-globals.message: Do not use, does not work in environments without SSL.

paths.name: @emoji-mart/data
paths.message: The emoji dataset is ~500KB; a static import pulls it into the initial bundle. Import the types only and load the data with loadEmojiIndex() from shared/utils/emoji, or loadEmojiData() from shared/editor/lib/emoji.

paths.name: emoji-mart
paths.message: emoji-mart shares a chunk with the ~500KB emoji dataset. Load it with loadEmojiIndex() from shared/utils/emoji instead of importing it statically.

patterns.message: Do not reference app code from shared code.
Do not reference server code from shared code.
Do not use the mime-types package in the browser.
